property_summary: On a fresh uninitialized C, calling rate() with any address that has no code must always revert.
On an uninitialized adapter (access control never set), every access-controlled admin call (setSlopes, setLimits) reverts for any input.
setSlopes reverts exactly when the kink is 0 or >= 1e27, and succeeds (accepting the slopes) for any kink strictly between 0 and 1e27.
Called directly on the implementation contract C (not behind a proxy), upgradeToAndCall always reverts for any implementation address and calldata.
Called directly on the implementation, C.proxiableUUID() never reverts and always returns the ERC-1967 implementation slot for any input.
For any vault address that has no deployed code, c.rate(vault, asset) always reverts, regardless of the asset.
